* A general class that reads all X9.62 style EC curve tables.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static X9ECParameters getByName(String name)
methods.comment:
* return a X9ECParameters object representing the passed in named
     * curve. The routine returns null if the curve is not present.
     *
     * @param name the name of the curve requested
     * @return an X9ECParameters object or null if the curve is not available.

methods.name: public static ASN1ObjectIdentifier getOID(String name)
methods.comment:
* return the object identifier signified by the passed in name. Null
     * if there is no object identifier associated with name.
     *
     * @return the object identifier associated with name, if present.

methods.name: public static String getName(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid)
methods.comment:
* return a X9ECParameters object representing the passed in named
     * curve.
     *
     * @param oid the object id of the curve requested
     * @return a standard name for the curve.

methods.name: public static X9ECParameters getByOID(ASN1ObjectIdentifier oid)
methods.comment:
* return a X9ECParameters object representing the passed in named
     * curve.
     *
     * @param oid the object id of the curve requested
     * @return an X9ECParameters object or null if the curve is not available.

methods.name: public static Enumeration getNames()
methods.comment:
* return an enumeration of the names of the available curves.
     *
     * @return an enumeration of the names of the available curves.

methods.name: private static void addEnumeration(Vector v, Enumeration e)
